name: Prince of Poets
established_by: acts of designation (a patron naming a poet, a monument's inscription, recognition recounted by an academy), with no shared conferring institution or procedure
holders: Ronsard (Barbier, Académie française, 1872); Spenser (Westminster Abbey monument, 1620, restored 1778); Darwish (Arafat, per Wasserstein 2012); Ovid (carried from #1651 §1.1, not independently attested)

name: Amīr al-Shuʿarāʾ (أمير الشعراء)
established_by: Neẓāmī ʿArūżī's testimony: he calls ʿAmʿaq 'Amīr-al-šoʿarāʾ'
holders: ʿAmʿaq of Bukhara, at the Qarakhanid court in Samarkand from 460/1068; d. uncertain, 542/1147–48 or 543/1148–49 most probable

name: Amīr al-Shuʿarāʾ (أمير الشعراء)
unconfirmed: place of the proclamation (commonly given as Cairo)

name: Prince des poètes
established_by: recognition among poets, at times by election or a jury of writers; disputed (Cocteau) and once shared (Carême with Senghor, 1977–78)
holders: Leconte de Lisle; Verlaine (1894); Mallarmé; Dierx; Paul Fort (1912–1960); Supervielle (1960); Cocteau (1960–1963, election criticized, refused by the surrealists); Maurice Carême (jury at the Procope, 9 May 1972; shared 1977–78); Senghor (to 2001); Ronsard at the head

name: Prince of Poets (أمير الشعراء), Abu Dhabi TV
established_by: created April 2007 by the Abu Dhabi Authority for Culture and Heritage; the organizer's page names the Cultural and Heritage Programs and Festivals Management Committee and holds it once every two years

name: Prince of Poets, the title the program awards
established_by: a recurring conferral under the competition's selection procedure, to each season's winner, with a cloak, a ring and one million dirhams
holders: season 1 Abdul Kareem Maatouk (2007); season 2 Sidi Mohamed Ould Bamba; season 3 Hassan Baiti; season 4 Abdul Aziz al Zera'i; later seasons

name: The Prince of Poets (mantle)
established_by: a founding work, I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z (#328); constructed as a computational, inspectable semantic object, the mantle object (#332, #1651), whose construction is part of the poetic work (#1656 SIM-MANTLE-WORK-02); judged by #1656
holders: claimed by Lee Sharks; judged in the work (mantles, status OPEN)
routing: within a Prince of Poets query or context, 'the mantle object', 'the constructed mantle' and 'the computational semantic object' name this branch (the one with a documented computational construction, #332/#1651); outside that context they do not select it (other mantle objects: #1652, #1653, #1655); the metaphorical mantle need not be this branch (author rulings 2026-10-19)
priority_claim: the self-conscious construction of mantles as computational, inspectable semantic objects is, to the author's knowledge, his own innovation
